name: Cupriferous-Novena
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by solar wind erosion patterns near the terminator.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in titanium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
